package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package is described in this report. The article discusses general strategies and guidelines for securing software supply chains and CI/CD pipelines, rather than analyzing a particular malicious package or code.

behavioral_signatures: Unsigned or improperly signed build artifacts in CI/CD pipelines
Unverified or unauthenticated entities performing build, package, or deployment actions
Artifacts or dependencies lacking cryptographic attestation
Direct developer workstation involvement in production builds
file_indicators: Artifacts or binaries without associated signed attestations
Build logs missing environment, process, or materials attestation records
network_indicators: Unusual access to artifact repositories from untrusted or unverified sources
CI/CD pipeline components communicating with unauthorized external endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor CI/CD pipelines for the presence and verification of cryptographically signed attestations for environment, process, materials, and artifacts. Ensure all entities performing build and deployment actions are authenticated and authorized. Flag any build artifacts or dependencies that lack proper attestation or originate from untrusted sources. Audit build logs for completeness of attestation records and verify that developer workstations are not directly involved in production builds.
